name: conflict-of-interest-checker
description: Conflict-of-Interest Checker — Claude Desktop plugin. Fuzzy-matches new-matter party names against your existing client/matter list — accounting for nicknames, entity-suffix variations, and misspellings — and returns a structured possible-conflict report. Never clears or declines a matter; the attorney makes every conflict determination.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version conflict-of-interest-checker-v$npm_package_version.zip conflict-of-interest-checker-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
